description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

Hand-built circuit, no LayerNorm: block 0 attention gathers the 10 digits to each position, block 0 MLP ANDs every (a_i,b_j) digit pair and sums d*e into column 8-i-j (gap 30), blocks 1-9 propagate carries one column each via ReLU threshold indicators on v=c_s+carry_s, block 10 reads out digit by position.
